QuestInfo.name: The Visitors
QuestInfo.0: Unfamiliar visitors have come to the sanctuary. All but one of them went to the altar to confirm there is no Transcendent. Talk to that one.
QuestInfo.1: Unfamiliar visitors have come to the sanctuary. All but one of them went to the altar to confirm there is no Transcendent. Talk to that one.
